result.title: Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning
result.summary: Catastrophic forgetting in sequential deep learning arises from a fixed-capacity architectural constraint: parameter updates encoding new tasks perturb weight subspaces supporting prior representations. We introduce the Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN), which mitigates the stability-plasticity trade-off in class-incremental learning through novelty-gated structural expansion rather than parameter negotiation within a shared capacity budget. KFN decouples task acquisition from knowledge consolidation: each incoming task is learned in an isolated lightweight specialist network (2.8M parameters) and integrated into the global model via a Structural Fusion Module that allocates dedicated channel capacity conditioned on a quantitative novelty score. Dual structural isolation--channel-space separation with temporally phased gradient unfreezing--protects consolidated knowledge. On ten-task Split CIFAR-100, KFN achieves 11.94% minimum task accuracy and 71.16% task-10 accuracy, whereas shared-parameter baselines degrade severely: LwF to 9.07% average accuracy (0.00% min), Replay++ to 8.91% (85.08% forgetting), and Replay to 16.21% (73.44% forgetting); KFN's forgetting (57.92%) is 15.5 pp lower than Replay. Furthermore, KFN prevents logit-scale drift, maintaining near-symmetric task performance. Across CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT satellite imagery, KFN's class-incremental retention (72.7% and 42.5%) substantially exceeds the best baselines (29.6% and 0.94%). Crucially, KFN achieves parameter-efficient linear scaling, adding 25% of the base parameter count per step and requiring 25.1% of naive backbone duplication over ten tasks (28.1M vs 112.0M). With a 37.1% peak GPU memory reduction over full retraining, KFN establishes novelty-gated expansion as a practical path beyond fixed-capacity architectures.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Knowledge Fusion Network：每个新任务先在独立的轻量 specialist 子网中学习，再经 Structural Fusion Module 按定量 novelty 分数分配专属通道容量完成融合，并以通道隔离与分阶段梯度解冻保护已有知识，在 Split CIFAR-100 与 EuroSAT 类增量分类上验证参数高效扩展。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文面向图像分类的持续学习，与 VLM 推理主线无直接关系；但其 novelty 门控的结构扩展与分阶段梯度解冻机制，可能为 latent 推理状态的持续更新、容量分配及避免信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索。
